title: Payment Channels
intro: Pay your water bill through any of the channels below, or in person at the CWD office.

items.name: GCash
items.description: Search "Camiling Water District" under Bills Pay in the GCash app.

items.name: Maya
items.description: Pay Bills > Government > Camiling Water District.

items.name: AllBank
items.description: Over-the-counter bills payment at any AllBank branch.

items.name: Bayad Center
items.description: Present your account number at any Bayad Center outlet.

items.name: 7-Eleven
items.description: Pay via CLiQQ kiosk or at the counter.

items.name: AllEasy
items.description: Bills payment app — search Camiling Water District.

items.name: PrimeWater App
items.description: Pay directly if your account is linked in the app.

items.name: Walk-in
items.description: Pay in person at the CWD office, cash or check.

notice_body: Have your account number ready (found on your most recent billing statement). Keep your payment reference number until the payment reflects on your next bill.
